points.description: States that the number of comparisons is related to the height of the tree (equivalently, about log of the number of elements, i.e. logarithmic).
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks for a related but incomplete statement, e.g. says it depends on the depth/path length or levels of the tree without saying height or log, or gives log n but only for a balanced tree with vague wording.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the comparisons equal the tree's height or about log of the number of elements, in any wording. Part marks for a vague or partly right answer, such as mentioning the path from the root or the depth of the tree without a clear link to height or log. No marks for answers like n comparisons or constant time, or for answers that don't address the count.
